source.why_this_clip: A single hamburger seen from the side fills the frame, a bun over a thick patty on a plate; it does not move and the camera holds nearly still. The interval starts after the dissolve from the hot dog shot ends near 18.0 s and stops before the cut to the wide table at 20.5 s; the earlier close-up at 13.75 to 15.0 s is too short before its dissolve.
